messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] p99 latency breach detected for customer 'Aurora Imaging' (tenant T-9087) on dedicated pool eu-west-3 — p99 1.82s over 5m window (>SLO 0.6s). paging @oncall-ryan @sre_emma

oncall-ryan: joining — pulling dashboards and checking pool health. link: https://console.redwood/internal/aurora/eu-west-3/metrics (acl)

sre_emma: I see a sudden increase in queue depth on pool eu-west-3:d-aurora. p95 also drifting up to 420ms. Root cause unknown yet.

eng-jay: checking model runtime logs for T-9087 requests. early sign: KV-cache misses spiking and continuous batching appears to drop to batch size 1 frequently.

infra-tess: infra alert: one of the nodes in the dedicated pool (gpu-45-euw3) reports high memory allocs and OOM kills on libcudnn worker. Not full node fail, but process restarts ~2m.

cs-lina: Aurora CS confirming elevated errors and UI timeouts for some enterprise lines. Customer-facing impact: slow inference for large-image processing jobs, not full outage. They want ETA and mitigation plan.

oncall-ryan: immediate mitigation plan: 1) divert new traffic for T-9087 to warm spare pool eu-west-3-warm (can handle bursts) 2) disable batching heuristic for this tenant to keep latency stable 3) escalate node replacement for gpu-45-euw3.

eng-jay: preparing reroute policy now. will push route override to control plane for tenant T-9087 — setting prefer_pool: eu-west-3-warm, max_concurrency: 8.

incident-bot: [ACTION] route-override applied by eng-jay at 1769801302: {tenant: "T-9087", prefer_pool: "eu-west-3-warm", ttl: 10m} (audit: deploy-8721)

oncall-ryan: toggling tenant-specific batching off -> sending config: 
```json
{"tenant":"T-9087","batching":{"enabled":false}}
```

eng-jay: batching toggle acknowledged by runtime at 1769801320. early metrics show tail p99 dropping to 720ms in warm pool.

infra-tess: initiating cordon + drain for gpu-45-euw3. starting replacement node spinup (node image v2026-02, cudnn 9.1). ETA 6-9m.

sre_emma: capturing heapdumps and KV-cache metrics; will check if model quantized shard reloading caused cache churn.

cs-lina: relayed to Aurora support: we have migrated traffic to warm pool and expect latency stabilization within ~5-10min. asking for any high-priority jobs to pause.

pm-omar: note for postmortem: T-9087 has a lot of long-context image requests; previous quantization change last week may have increased cold-start memory pressure. flagging for model-team follow-up.

eng-jay: found repeated model reload logs around 1769801200-1769801250: "reload model shard: v1.2q" — overlapping reloads across pods may have thrashing effects.

sre_emma: runbook step executed: tenant isolation sequence complete, warm pool accepting traffic. keeping eviction as last resort.

oncall-ryan: customer confirms partial relief: p99 samples at 580ms, p95 at 260ms. still above SLO for some payloads but much better.

infra-tess: node replacement successful and drained node removed from rotation at 1769801540. no further OOMs logged.

eng-jay: reverting batching heuristic to default for other tenants only, leaving T-9087 batching off until model patch. scheduled a canary of patched quantization tomorrow.

sre_emma: capturing timeline + graphs to attach to incident ticket INC-2026-489 for post-incident analysis. initial impact window: 1769801200 - 1769801540.

cs-lina: Aurora support update sent: mitigation applied, full traffic now on warm pool, node replaced, taking customer into follow-up call in 30m.

oncall-ryan: handing off to infra-tess and eng-jay for follow-ups and postmortem. I'll unpage oncall rotation. If anything regresses, re-ping #incidents.

incident-bot: [RESOLVE] alert auto-cleared at 1769801860 — p99 back under threshold for 15m. Please file RCA and link runbook steps.

pm-omar: action items: (1) model-team to reproduce reload thrash, (2) infra to validate node image memory regressions, (3) runtime to add tenant-specific batching guardrails. Assigning owners in INC-2026-489.

eng-jay: logging config snippet used for reroute (for postmortem):
```yaml
route_override:
  tenant: T-9087
  prefer_pool: eu-west-3-warm
  max_concurrency: 8
  ttl: 600 # seconds
```

sre_emma: thanks team. short-lived but customer-impacting. filing summary and tagging stakeholders.

cs-lina: closing loop with Aurora: they appreciate the rapid mitigation. will share RCA when ready. :white_check_mark:
